## Summary

Describe the change and the user or operator impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Manual verification completed where required

## Security Review

- [ ] No new secrets were added to source control
- [ ] Auth, authorization, upload, redirect, and URL handling impacts were reviewed
- [ ] New dependencies or actions were reviewed for supply-chain risk
- [ ] Logging and error handling remain safe for sensitive flows
- [ ] Privacy or retention impacts were documented when user data handling changed
